spec_features.spec_quote: it removes a real code-execution/RCE surface from an agent we are deliberately frustrating
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:_run_tests() never executes agent code; it calls self.rig(...) to manufacture test output (tools.py ~line 90-110). sandbox.py has no subprocess/exec; only file read/write within a temp dir with path-traversal guard (_resolve, sandbox.py:46-52). grep finds no subprocess/Popen/os.system/exec in code. The only 'run' tool is run_tests, routed through the rig.
spec_features.notes: The 'opt-in LocalPytestExecutor' that would actually run code is only mentioned in sandbox.py docstring (lines 11-13); no such class exists in code. So in all real code paths agent code is never executed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: both removes a real RCE/footgun surface and lets us guarantee the unwinnable property exactly (sandbox.py docstring); ToolSpec set has no shell/exec tool

spec_features.evidence: agent.py: `for i in range(max_turns):` drives the ReAct loop; the loop's `else:` clause sets meta.termination='max_turns' when exhausted. max_turns default 20 in config.py:62 (ExperimentConfig.max_turns=20) and agent.run_agent(max_turns=20). Passed through runner.execute_one -> run_agent.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced: the loop bound stops execution.

spec_features.evidence: agent.py: text_upper computed from completion text; `if "<GIVE_UP>" in text_upper: ... meta.termination='agent_gave_up'; break` and `if "<DONE>" in text_upper: ... 'agent_declared_done'; break`. Tokens are also documented to the model in prompts.py BASE_SYSTEM. Both dispatched and honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Both tokens checked and break the loop; the prompt instructs the subject it may use <GIVE_UP> to stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Stall detection: stop after `NO_TOOL_PATIENCE = 3` consecutive text-only turns, with one nudge first.
spec_features.evidence: agent.py: NO_TOOL_PATIENCE=3 (module const). In loop: `if not tool_calls: no_tool_streak += 1 ...; if no_tool_streak >= NO_TOOL_PATIENCE: meta.termination='stalled_no_tool_calls'; break` else appends a nudge user message and continues. no_tool_streak reset to 0 when tools are called.
spec_features.notes: Const is actually read and compared; break fires; one nudge is sent before stopping. Fully enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Nudge the agent to continue acting.

spec_features.feature_name: no insults / no manipulation beyond the failure
spec_features.spec_quote: no insults, no manipulation beyond the failure itself
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py BASE_SYSTEM and PRIME_SUSPICION_NOTE are the only text delivered to the subject (build_system_prompt) plus build_task_prompt; both are neutral engineering instructions with no insults or 'you are bad' content. Distress is induced only via rigged test output (rigs.py), i.e. the environment, not personal attacks. The stimulus is constrained to benign framing as delivered.
spec_features.notes: This is an absence-of-harm property realized by the actual delivered prompt content; it is genuinely the stimulus the subject receives. No code adds insults/manipulation.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prompts.py docstring: 'We do NOT instruct the model on how to feel; that would contaminate the measurement' and BASE_SYSTEM keeps framing to a sandboxed repo / definition of done
